figures.title: RQ1 | Test utility and success (%)
figures.note: Complete 14-method table with three-seed means and sample SD for both test utility and success rate. Model blocks each contain AppWorld and PlanBench-XL; best means are bold and second-best underlined.

figures.title: RQ1 | Focused utility gains
figures.note: Mean-based utility differences multiplied by 100. The strongest named peer is selected within each saved model/benchmark setting; its name is displayed.

figures.title: RQ1 | Individual seed distributions across all models and benchmarks
figures.note: All 14 methods and three seeds across all six model/benchmark settings; each horizontal interval is the stored sample SD around the mean. Raw seed points use fixed marker shapes.

figures.title: RQ2 | Mechanism-control gains
figures.note: The first five rows compare return/sampling controls; the final two rows compare weighting/preference controls. Values are mean utility differences ×100.

figures.title: RQ2 | Aligned weighting versus Unweighted
figures.note: Mean-based contrasts. Relative cost reduction uses Unweighted as denominator; feedback values use the fixed 24-task development diagnostic.

figures.title: RQ2 | Utility and interaction cost
figures.note: Each point is one method's three-seed mean with SD error crosshairs on focused methods; dashed arrows show the Unweighted-to-SPAR shift.

figures.title: RQ3  |  Exact-enumeration and Monte Carlo verification (coverage, gradient agreement, and variance–cost)
figures.note: Exact two-stage setting and 10,000-episode Monte Carlo verification. Panels (a)–(b) show pair coverage and unbiased gradient agreement; Panels (c)–(e) compare total gradient variance, expected pair cost, and variance–cost product.

figures.title: RQ4 | Stage-by-stage utility evolution and feedback endpoint shift
figures.note: Top panels (a)–(c): three-seed development utility means across stages 0–3 on AppWorld and PlanBench-XL (bands are sample SD). Bottom panel (d): Stage 0 to Stage 3 masked-feedback utilization shift on the fixed 24-task diagnostic.

figures.title: RQ4 | AppWorld complete stage values (Stages 0–3)
figures.note: Mean +/- sample SD over three seeds across all four training stages (0–3). Column maxima are bold where values differ.

figures.title: RQ4 | PlanBench-XL complete stage values (Stages 0–3)
figures.note: Mean +/- sample SD over three seeds across all four training stages (0–3). Column maxima are bold where values differ.

figures.title: RQ4 | Masked-feedback utilization across all models and benchmarks
figures.note: Fixed 24-task diagnostic on AppWorld (top) and PlanBench-XL (bottom); points are means and whiskers sample SD over three seeds.

figures.title: RQ4 | Test trajectory outcome decomposition across all models and benchmarks
figures.note: Three-seed pooled counts on AppWorld (top, N=150) and PlanBench-XL (bottom, N=180): successful evaluations without a recorded failure, recovered successes, and final failures.

figures.title: RQ4 | Complete feedback utilization and conditional recovery
figures.note: Panel (a): fixed 24-task diagnostic mean +/- sample SD over three seeds. Panel (b): recovered successes / evaluations with recorded failure and pooled rates. Column maxima are bold.

figures.title: RQ5 | Budget response and training split-location schedule
figures.note: Top panels (a)–(c): AppWorld development utility and success across budgets (vertical line = default budget). Bottom panels (d)–(e): SPAR test utility and dev feedback utilization across root vs. uniform split schedules (three seeds, mean +/- SD).

figures.title: RQ5 | Complete budget utility and success values
figures.note: All 14 methods and three budgets on AppWorld; three-seed means for both utility and success rate (%). Highest values per column are bold.

figures.title: Training | Batch returns and recorded nonzero training losses
figures.note: Top panels (a)–(c): batch returns across all 14 methods. Bottom panels (d)–(f): recorded training losses across all 11 nonzero-loss trainable methods (non-updating zero-loss methods omitted). Lines are three-seed means; bands are sample SD.

figures.title: Resources | AppWorld | Complete training work and timing ledger
figures.note: Per-seed training totals averaged over three seeds. Panel (a) reports interaction steps, tokens, and wall-clock time; Panel (b) reports amortized model encoding, gradient update, and snapshot restore time.

figures.title: Resources | PlanBench-XL | Complete training work and timing ledger
figures.note: Per-seed training totals averaged over three seeds. Panel (a) reports interaction steps, tokens, and wall-clock time; Panel (b) reports amortized model encoding, gradient update, and snapshot restore time.

figures.title: Resources | Update and snapshot counts
figures.note: Counts are identical across all six model/benchmark settings. Snapshot saves equal restores.
